_comment: Maintainer-tested results. Community reports (GitHub issues labelled 'compatibility') are merged in docs/data/reports.json by .github/workflows/compat-data.yml. Mods in "hidden" are not listed (engine patches and other mods with nothing to do on 1.21.1, client-side mods that have their own 1.21.1 version); the tools/compat scripts skip them.

mods.name: AbyssalCraft
mods.notes: Survival-tested 2026-11-01: the Gateway Key builds the portal and a survival player enters the Abyssal Wasteland; all four dimensions load with their own biomes; 166 blocks break and drop, 440 recipes and the chest/mob loot tables load, mobs drop their loot. The Transmutator burns fuel and cooks; the ritual altar runs a ritual end to end (range charm: pedestal offerings consumed, charm dropped). Chagaroth (damage cap, spawns, fists) dies and drops dread keys, dreadium and XP; Jzahar spawns and drops a scroll. Server-tested 2026-11-01 (second pass): crystallizer (shards, fuel), engraver (azathoth coin, engraving wears) and materializer (bag of crystals lists the recipe) work with valid recipe inputs; the sacrificial altar collects Potential Energy from a slain cow; the relay moves PE collector -> container; NecroDataCapability (Necronomicon unlocks) works; all 47 non-projectile entity types spawn and tick; plague and antimatter effects apply. Still untried: the other sacrifice rituals, spirit altar and statues, the Necronomicon GUI, Dreadlands/Omothol structure chests, tool/armour effects, Asorah/Sacthoth/Gatekeeper/Jzahar phases. Known: the mod's ACExplosion scheduler indexes Chunk.getBlockStorageArray with y<0 in 1.21 worlds (blocks below y=0 exist) and throws every tick until the explosion finishes (large Dread/antimatter bombs only). Known: with C2ME some Omothol chunks log a populate error (mob random used off-thread; being fixed). Item models of crystal subtypes and OBJ weapons fixed after 0.3.13 (#129).
